name: Cloud Task Orchestrator
shortDescription: Distributed job processing engine with real-time analytics dashboard.
detailedDescription: A robust task scheduling and queueing platform built to handle asynchronous workloads across microservices. Features resilient retry mechanisms, telemetry instrumentation, and a clean web management interface.
keyFeatures: Dynamic real-time telemetry dashboard with WebSocket streaming
Role-based access control and detailed audit logs

name: DevMetrics CI/CD Pulse
shortDescription: Interactive engineering productivity & DORA metrics visualizer.
detailedDescription: Modern web dashboard providing engineering leads with actionable insights into deployment frequency, lead time for changes, and change failure rates from VCS webhooks.
keyFeatures: Modular dashboard widgets with configurable grid layouts
Sub-second client filtering across 50,000+ pipeline records
Comprehensive keyboard shortcuts and high-contrast accessibility

name: Nexus KV Store
shortDescription: High-throughput in-memory key-value cache with Raft consensus.
detailedDescription: Lightweight distributed caching store implementing peer discovery, leader election, and write-ahead logging to guarantee partition tolerance and consistency.
keyFeatures: P99 latency of under 4ms under synthetic benchmark loads
Prometheus metrics exporter for node cluster monitoring

name: DocuPulse Static CMS
shortDescription: Blazing fast documentation generator with full-text search.
detailedDescription: A developer-first documentation generator with instantaneous client-side fuzzy search, live MDX previews, and automated sitemap generation.
keyFeatures: Wasm-powered client fuzzy search index under 20KB
Dark mode first design system with syntax highlighting

name: HyperGateway Proxy
shortDescription: Extensible reverse proxy and rate limiting gateway service.
detailedDescription: Configurable API gateway featuring token bucket rate limiting, JWT validation middleware, and upstream circuit breaking.
keyFeatures: Token-bucket rate limiting per IP / API key
Circuit breaker preventing upstream cascading failures

name: GraphDraft Canvas
shortDescription: Browser-based architecture diagramming tool with SVG export.
detailedDescription: Interactive canvas for engineering diagrams with smart edge snapping, undo/redo history trees, and zero external layout dependencies.
keyFeatures: 60 FPS rendering of 500+ interconnected canvas nodes
Export to SVG, PNG, and JSON schema
